nina_pm: Quick sync : new tenant-aware rollout for smart-routing. Need concise canary ladder + failover story.
omar_eng: propose: shadow -> micro (0.2%) -> tenant pilots (3 tenants) -> regional ramp (10%) -> broad (50%) -> global. Manual gate after pilots.
kevin_sre: safety thresholds: 5xx rate > 0.25% over baseline for 5m OR p95 latency +75ms -> abort. Also require queue depth stable (<10% growth).
yasmin_platform: flag model: `smart_route_v3` with fields: `stage_pct`, `pilot_tenants`, `tenant_override`, `auto_advance`. Include webhook for abort events.
omar_eng: A/B inside active pct: 70% control / 30% candidate to bias towards safety. Collect evaluation sample of 7k requests per stage.
nina_pm: Quality pass: no regression >1% on eval set, error delta <0.2%, cost delta <5%. PM signoff required for global.
kevin_sre: add cache-affinity check: if cache miss delta >12% for 20m, pause. Also monitor sticky session drop >0.8%.
yasmin_platform: snippet for rollout YAML in the runbook: ```yaml
flag: smart_route_v3
stages:
  - name: shadow
    mode: shadow
    duration_min: 120
  - name: micro
    pct: 0.2
    duration_min: 30
  - name: pilots
    pilot_tenants: [acct-120, acct-450, acct-998]
    duration_h: 48
  - name: regional
    pct: 10
    duration_min: 60
  - name: broad
    pct: 50
    duration_min: 120
manual_gate_after: pilots
abort_on: ["5xx>0.25%","p95+75ms","cache_miss+12%"]
```
omar_eng: infra will add per-tenant force-off and audit logs. Also provide `simulate-route` for QA.
kevin_sre: escalation: auto-rollback -> open incident -> notify CS & list affected tenants. If >2 pilot tenants fail, stop global schedule.
flag-bot: Draft flag created by yasmin_platform: smart_route_v3. Reminder set: 1812350599 -> shadow start.
nina_pm: communications: pre-notify pilot tenants and CS 24h before pilot stage. Post status at manual gate.
yasmin_platform: instrumentation: add tags `route.variant`, `route.reason`, `tenant.id`. Emit `route.latency_delta_ms` and `route.cache_miss_pct`.
omar_eng: test plan: unit + e2e, 2h shadow with synthetic traffic, divergence checker for responses, dry-run of tenant opt-outs.
kevin_sre: I'll own oncall for rollout. Creating runbook with kill-switch and checklist.
nina_pm: owners: nina_pm (PM), omar_eng (eng lead), kevin_sre (SRE), yasmin_platform (flags). Closing unless blockers. :thumbsup:
